review: Liu Ishmael is a burn ID that performs well in every scenario, but truly shines when put in a burn team. Her damage is pretty average and clashes are really average with the exception of her S2. She also can gain 1 Plus Coin Power, although it's through a pretty annoying conditional. Notable E.G.O. Synergies: Capote - Additional burn application, team wide support and boost to Skill 2 damage under certain circumstances. Ardor Blossom Star - One of the better damaging and clashing E.G.Os. that allows for burn spread, helping in battles with multiple enemies / body parts.
